verdict.rationale: doola is a SaaS formation and compliance platform, so choosing a data-storage region is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the pack documents any option to choose a data region or residency. The "No U.S. residency" claim refers to the founder's own residency, choosing a formation state is a legal-jurisdiction choice, and "secure storage" of mail scans names no storage location; none of these is data residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
